2607.08268.title: Different Teachers, Different Capabilities: Sub-1B On-Device Distillation for Structured Text Enrichment
2607.08268.paper_summary: High-volume structured extraction pays a large model's latency on every item, so distilling the task into a small on-device model is attractive: comparable output at a fraction of the time and cost. We measure what that distillation actually delivers, per sub-task. Each news article is mapped to one JSON object with a short summary and five categorical labels. We distill an 8B reasoning teacher (deepseek-r1:8b) into a 0.6B student (Qwen3-0.6B; QLoRA, three seeds), and add two teacher controls: a same-size non-reasoning teacher and a larger managed pipeline. A blinded, reference-free, three-judge panel scores every arm against the full article, alongside two non-distillation baselines, few-shot prompting and constrained decoding. The student runs at about 0.8 s per article against the teacher's 39 s, and recovers 58% of the base-to-teacher gap on summary quality, beating its primary baseline (constrained decoding) by +16.8 points and few-shot prompting by a secondary +4.9. A same-size non-reasoning teacher trains a student no better than the untuned base, so the summary gain follows from the teacher's reasoning nature rather than its scale. Capabilities then split by teacher: the reasoning teacher transfers writing quality and the managed pipeline transfers label diversity, while a same-size instruction teacher's students stay more grounded on the 22 short, thin-source articles in the 93-item test set (74 versus 55 faithful), where the reasoning-lineage student fabricates. That grounding difference is a consistent ordering rather than a significant aggregate effect, and the subgroup is small, so we report it as a direction. Because no single engine wins every field, the deliverable is a per-field routing map for on-device enrichment.
2607.08268.paper_summary_zh: 高容量的結構化提取在每個項目上都需要一個大型模型的延遲，因此將任務提煉成一個小型的設備端模型是有吸引力的：在時間和成本上以較小的比例產生可比的輸出。我們測量每個子任務實際交付的提煉效果。每篇新聞文章被映射到一個包含簡短摘要和五個類別標籤的 JSON 對象。我們將一個 8B 的推理教師（deepseek-r1:8b）提煉成一個 0.6B 的學生（Qwen3-0.6B；QLoRA，三個種子），並添加兩個教師控制：一個同等大小的非推理教師和一個更大的管理管道。一個盲評、無參考的三人評審小組對每個組別進行評分，並與完整文章進行比較，還有兩個非提煉的基準，少量提示和受限解碼。學生的運行時間約為每篇文章 0.8 秒，而教師的運行時間為 39 秒，並在摘要質量上恢復了 58% 的基準到教師的差距，超過了其主要基準（受限解碼）16.8 分，並在少量提示上超過了次要的 4.9 分。同等大小的非推理教師對學生的訓練效果不比未調整的基準好，因此摘要的增益源於教師的推理特性而非其規模。能力則根據教師的不同而有所區分：推理教師轉移了寫作質量，而管理管道轉移了標籤多樣性，而同等大小的指導教師的學生在 93 項測試集中的 22 篇短小、薄來源文章上表現得更為踏實（74 對 55 的忠實度），而推理系譜的學生則存在虛構。這種踏實的差異是一種一致的排序，而不是顯著的總體效果，且子群體較小，因此我們將其報告為一個方向。因為沒有單一引擎能在每個領域中獲勝，交付的成果是一個針對設備端增強的每個領域路由圖。
2607.08268.author: Vinay Kumar Chaganti et.al.
